'''Mike Mason''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Columbus tournament (13 January)]] on 13 January 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]], according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ columbus-ohio-1-13-01], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 14 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-14-columbus-ohio-1-13-01d1619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
